overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation updates, and establishing a fixed-point physics accumulator for endgame stability.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a constexpr-friendly FNV-1a hash for POD structs. Use std::span for contiguous memory traversal. No virtual functions. Static inline functions for 100% inlining. Handle endianness via std::endian::native checks. Max 40 lines.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hash values are identical across x86_64 and ARM64 builds. Zero heap allocations during hashing. Unit tests pass for 1000 random state permutations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save games are never corrupted, providing a reliable experience for long-session players.

tasks.title: Fixed-Point Accumulator for Endgame Stability
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a 64-bit fixed-point type with 32-bit integer and 32-bit fractional parts. Implement addition, subtraction, and multiplication as constexpr. Avoid floating-point drift in long-running simulations. Max 50 lines.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 10,000 iterations of addition/subtraction yield exact results. No NaN or Infinity states. Compatible with existing float-based renderer via explicit conversion.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Prevents 'jitter' in object positions after 5000+ ticks, keeping the visual experience crisp.

tasks.title: Zero-Alloc Psychology State Machine
tasks.architectural_spec: Use a union-based state representation for colonist moods. Implement a transition table using std::array of function pointers. No dynamic memory. State changes are O(1). Max 55 lines.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: State transitions occur in <1ns. No memory fragmentation observed in profiler. All 12 mood states reachable from initial state.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks allow for more complex colony layouts without lag.
